verdict.rationale: Synctera docs show elements relevant to onboarding ops work: KYC/KYB verification and PROSPECT status flows (docs-9/18/31/32), document verification (docs-10), enhanced due diligence for high-risk cases (docs-28), case notifications for employees (docs-27), and a stated goal of centralized operational workflows with 'complete data visibility and seamless collaboration' between the fintech and bank partner (docs-16). This covers document supply and some collaboration framing, but there's no explicit description of a pending-application queue UI, no articulation of which decisions are ops-owned vs bank-owned, and no evidence of a 'reason for pending' surface. Missing for 10: a documented onboarding queue/dashboard view, explicit decision-rights split between ops and bank partner, and hands-on/independent corroboration of the ops workflow.
